prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW landscape 1536x864 gameplay art direction image for Dark Nights, a 2D SIDE-VIEW cooperative underground exploration game. Input 1 is ONLY the flat hand-drawn rock/ink art style reference, NOT its spacious layout or bright lighting. Input 2 is the existing hero identity: enormous round pale cyan hood, simple beige face, tiny cyan body, black ink outline. Keep this charming simple identity; do not turn characters into realistic astronauts. Include two such small explorers to show cooperative scale, one with a handheld flashlight and the other a pickaxe. Redesign the actual SPACE to feel claustrophobic, dark and dangerous. Strict lateral cutaway view with a very small visible ground top surface, no isometric or first-person perspective. One continuous natural winding cave tunnel: huge solid rock masses occupy 65-75% of the frame; close low irregular ceiling hangs just 1.4 to 2 hero heights above the path across most of the scene, with a single small pocket of 3 hero heights. Hero approximately 85 px tall in an 864px high image. The path gently descends and bends through constrictions. Solid rock occupies the entire top third and bottom third, in large simple angular charcoal-brown shapes, black hand-ink outlines, only 2-3 flat cel shade values. The backwall is CLOSE, dim charcoal slate with only sparse broad facets, not a vast open blue cavern or a distant forest of stalactites. Black wedges at bends hide the passage ahead. Characters stand on readable local rocky footing left of center, flashlight pointed right, a small warm ivory cone reveals ONLY the immediate next stretch, the low ceiling edge, a few loose pebbles below a fractured roof slab, and one modest copper/gold ore exposure embedded in the wall. Reflected light faintly reads the second cyan hero; no huge circular spotlight. Rock blocks light; no illumination through walls. Far edges nearly black but local walking silhouette and heroes remain crisp. No continuous yellow road, no self-glowing ore, no neon, no torch infrastructure, no monsters, no stairs, no bridges, no preplaced ladders, no HUD, no labels, no decorative text. The interest must come from cramped uneven geology, occlusion, limited visibility and the uncertain bend, not added enemies. Stylized clean flat illustration, little texture, no painterly photographic rock, no blur. A compelling actual side-scrolling game screen concept, not a poster.

Use case: stylized-concept. NEW 1536x864 landscape companion gameplay concept for Dark Nights. Reference image 1 provides EXACT art language and oppressive underground mood: bold black ink contours, large charcoal-brown flat rock facets, low light, cute pale-cyan heroes. Reference 2 is hero identity. Create a DIFFERENT space, a modest wider mineral pocket after a constricted passage, while staying dark and dangerous. Strict 2D side-scrolling lateral cutaway, thin readable top edges of floors, no isometric aerial view, no perspective tunnel vanishing point. Same camera scale as reference: two cyan hooded characters about 85px tall, NOT microscopic figures. A narrow low tunnel enters from the LEFT, floor slopes gently down into a small irregular central chamber with about 3-4 character heights of air, then climbs over a low rock shoulder to a SECOND narrow horizontal passage exiting RIGHT at roughly the same height. Thick unbroken solid rock ceiling and floor frame this pocket, occupying most of the canvas; massive low hanging ceiling lobes and a darker near-plane rock buttress partly occlude the chamber's far right edge. Do NOT make an enormous empty cave hall. Layout should be clearly read as tight entrance -> briefly wider pocket -> hidden tight continuation, in ONE image. Central ground has enough room for 2-4 players to work and pass each other. Two existing cyan heroes stand close on the left side of the pocket, one holding a short pickaxe, one pointing a handheld flashlight at a SMALL exposed mineral seam on the inner right wall. Flashlight and reflected light illuminate a limited patch of rough wall, damp rocky floor and the cyan suits; far route past the rock shoulder disappears in near-blackness. A fractured ceiling slab and a few fallen chips provide restrained environmental danger cues. Ore is embedded, copper-ochre and not emissive. Background is predominantly a CLOSE dark slate backwall; only ONE narrow vertical dark gap suggests deeper unknown space, with minimal muted blue depth. No full-screen blue background, no glowing yellow continuous road, no turquoise crystal flood, no sky, no sunlight, no torches, no ladders, no bridge, no monster, no giant chasm requiring a new traversal mechanic, no text or HUD. Keep terrain edge readable in illuminated area and preserve expressive clean simple cartoon drawing; 2-3 cel-shade values, no realistic noisy detail or fog blur. Wider space should feel like a risky discovery and a place to stop mining, still enclosed, NOT a safe brightly lit arena.
